description: Found by extending sql-execution-gate to TPC-Havoc. Havoc 1_v7 uses DuckDB LIST(...); benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dialect_compat.py LIST_AGGREGATE_DIALECTS covers only sqlite and cloud dialects, so PostgreSQL fails (`function list(numeric) does not exist`) and DataFusion fails (`Invalid function 'list'`). Add the targets to the dispatch data and make the fork's reduce_list_aggregates/order_list_aggregates produce valid PostgreSQL (array_agg) and DataFusion (array_agg) forms. Check every other target platform for the same gap. GUARDRAILS: fix in the SQLGlot fork with real-engine tests (fork CI) and adopt via a wheel cut under the batch wheel mutex; benchmark text unchanged; when fixed, remove the matching sql-execution-gate allowlist entry (the gate fails on stale entries); list affected published bundles and flag only if recorded rows were wrong; no cloud spend.
